model_annotations.English: Figure 2 consists of two pie charts, labeled (a) and (b), representing the distribution of tokens that most frequently co-occur with the word "reaction" in the domains of chemistry and mathematics, respectively. Chart (a) displays six distinct categories, with an accompanying legend located immediately above the pie. The slices are arranged in descending order of size in a clockwise direction, starting from the upper right, and represent the tokens "the" (patterned blue with diagonal stripes, 31%), "this" (orange, 21%), "for" (green, 15%), "chemical" (purple-grey, 15%), "to" (yellow, 9%), and "in" (dark blue, 7%). Chart (b) displays four categories, also featuring a legend positioned above it. Similar to the first chart, its segments are ordered clockwise by broadly descending percentage, consisting of "the" (patterned blue with diagonal stripes, 38%), "$" (orange, 27%), "equilibrium" (green, 19%), and "constant" (purple-grey, 15%). In both charts, there are no exploded or visually emphasized slices, and the percentage labels are positioned just outside the perimeter of the pie segments rather than internally.
